_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN): row S-04 (refused lock + reload). No model call; scripted new_chat_only opener. ST's setPersonaLockState cannot be wrapped from the page (personas.js is an ES module, its exports are read-only bindings), so the refusal is made where it lands: lockPersona('chat') only assigns chat_metadata.persona, and a PERSONA_CHANGED listener (ST's emit awaits it inside setUserAvatar, after its reloadCurrentChat replaced chat_metadata) defines that property with a setter that drops the write; the product's lock then reads 'the chat did not take the persona lock', exactly the jest refusal. Pass 1: pick SO-V2734 Tamsin, refused: [data-so=player-setup-lock-failed], persona-lock (blocks) in the start modal, #so-setup and the HUD count (#so-hud-setup data-blocks), the blob playerSetup {pending, lockFailed} in memory and on the server copy, no opener; the reload verb reloads the page (the trap goes with the old chat_metadata) and the record, the notice and the absent opener all survive; Try again ([data-so=player-setup-retry]) locks Tamsin on the server and posts the opener once. Pass 2 (after unlock + Restart): refuse again on Wren, then Start without keeping it ([data-so=player-setup-unlocked]): opener once, record locked false, no lock on the server, journal 'continued without the chat lock'. BUILD: the S-04 row says prod, but so-scenario needs the dev bundle's storyOrchestratorRuntime handle (import_story, snapshot reads) and refuses a prod page, so this file is the dev-build form of the row; a prod run needs a DOM-only driver. Open: S30-1 (the pick's persona switch reloads the group chat) may lapse the choice before the lock; a red at the first lock-failed wait is that question answered. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-34-lock-refused.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" on a no-model dev lane.

requires.why: the refusal is an in-page trap on chat_metadata.persona; the persona writes need a lane
